# featbit_group_member_binding (Resource)

Manages one exact FeatBit Group-to-Member binding through the documented public API. It owns only the configured pair, not either endpoint or the Group's complete Member collection.

This resource owns only one exact pair. It does not own the Group, the Member,
or the Group's complete Member collection. The Member must already exist; this
provider does not invite, create, update, remove from the organization or
workspace, or delete Members. If the pair already exists, Create adopts that
relationship into state without another add mutation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "group_name" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact Group name."
  type        = string
}

variable "member_email" {
  description = "Organization-scoped full email of an existing FeatBit Member."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

data "featbit_group" "target" {
  name = var.group_name
}

data "featbit_member" "target" {
  email = var.member_email
}

resource "featbit_group_member_binding" "example" {
  group_id  = data.featbit_group.target.id
  member_id = data.featbit_member.target.id
}
```

Member identifiers and the synthetic binding ID are Sensitive. Treat state,
plans, and terminal output as confidential even though the example contains
no real Member value.

## Lifecycle

- Changing either endpoint replaces the binding.
- Read scans the complete Group Member collection for this exact pair.
- Destroy removes only this pair and preserves every unrelated membership.
- Removing the binding never deletes or changes the Member profile. Destroy
  bindings before their managed Group.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Exact Group UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.
- `member_id` (String, Sensitive) Exact existing Member UUID. Changing it replaces the binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String, Sensitive) Canonical synthetic binding ID in `<group_uuid>/<member_uuid>` form.

## Import

Import one exact Group-Member pair:

```shell
terraform import featbit_group_member_binding.example '<group_uuid>/<member_uuid>'
```

Both components must use canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID form. The
Member component and resulting synthetic ID are Sensitive in Terraform.
